body:
## Environment

- main nightly `b94ac87e` (2026-07-13), 8×B300, DeepSeek-V4-Pro (DSpark checkpoint), 1P1D PD disaggregation, prefill TP4 + decode TP4, mooncake TCP transfer.

## Symptom

With `--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1` (default) the V4 hybrid SWA pool came out as `swa=20992` tokens (`DSV4 pool sizes: full=212224, swa=20992, ...`). Any request whose prompt is longer than roughly `swa_pool − 512` tokens:

- is bootstrapped and finalized into `waiting_queue` normally, but is **never admitted into a prefill batch** — no error, no rejection, no log;
- because the scheduler is FCFS, it pins the queue head and **everything behind it starves too** (even the 30s internal health-check generate), which surfaces as `Server couldn't get a response from detokenizer for last 20 seconds` spam;
- when the client eventually aborts, the queue head clears and the pipeline instantly recovers — which makes the whole thing look like a flaky "random hang" under real traffic where only occasional requests are long.

Length ladder on our setup: 16333-token prompt schedules instantly, 20742-token prompt hangs forever. With `chunked_prefill_size=32768` the wall moves to ~20.4K; the numbers precisely track `_swa_budget_for_req = min(len, chunked_prefill_size) + page_size` vs. SWA pool capacity.

## Root cause

`PrefillAdder` checks `_swa_budget_for_req(...) > rem_swa_tokens` and simply defers the request. When the budget exceeds the **total** SWA pool capacity (not just the currently-available part), deferring can never succeed — the request is unschedulable by construction, but nothing detects that, so it waits forever and blocks the FCFS queue.

Anyone running V4 PD with `chunked_prefill_size` larger than the SWA pool (which is easy: default ratio 0.1 gives a ~21K-token pool while common chunk sizes are 16K-32K) will hit this on their first long prompt.

## Suggested fix

At admission (or at `handle_generate_request`), if `min(len, chunked_prefill_size) + page_size > swa_pool_total_capacity`, fail fast with an HTTP 400 (like the existing `max_total_num_tokens` check in `_check_if_req_exceed_kv_capacity`) instead of silently deferring forever. A startup warning when `chunked_prefill_size + page_size > swa_pool_size` would also prevent the misconfiguration in the first place.

We can submit a PR for either/both if the direction sounds right.
title: [Bug] PD prefill silently starves forever when a request's SWA budget exceeds the SWA pool (DeepSeek-V4 hybrid pool)
